summary: Fresh live evidence showed FANIN_LAG was not caused by the metabolism trigger: unconsumed_returns_trigger was already 2 while a GUIDE_INTEGRATOR carrying 12 recent unconsumed return refs appeared sixth in the compact frontier. The allocator ordering was hardened so a RETURNS_UNCONSUMED GUIDE_INTEGRATOR with >=8 exact evidence refs is elevated ahead of ordinary integration/recovery/reserve work while human-durable/product work remains protected. A deterministic 4-case fixture covers 7-vs-8 burst behavior and product precedence. Fresh gh-pages projection then placed the 12-return Integrator first.

measurement.latency_quantile_reason: Insufficient comparable durable return->consumed timestamp pairs in the bounded sampled window; quantiles intentionally not invented.
